goal: Remove the six route traps of TIER-WORDING-2 (BACKLOG P2 2026-10-01, items a-f) without weakening any gate: a clean failure path of the goal harness, an early oracle-leg check, a hard stop for overwriting a fresh session memory file, the /test rules for unique mutation markers and escaped fixtures, a failed harness attempt that does not block the next one, and a harness verdict independent of local ignored files, and a completion gate without false red layers (approved by the owner 2026-10-01; one unit per session).

units.criterion: GOALVERIFY-FAILPATH-1: when a compound verificationCommand fails, skills/goal/scripts/itd_goal_verify.py prints the decisive line 'FAILED <unit> stays in_progress' with the per-leg evidence and exits 1 without a traceback (no UnboundLocalError on output), the single-command and no-sh failure paths keep their output; the new oracle tests/verify_goal_verify_failpath.py is RED on the pre-fix code and GREEN after, and tests/verify_goal_tools.py and tests/verify_goal_verify_shell.py stay green.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_goal_verify_failpath.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_goal_tools.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_goal_verify_shell.py

units.criterion: COMPLETION-FALSE-RED-1: the completion signals (hooks/completion_lib.py) and the completion gate stop counting three expected outcomes as a red test layer - the expected failures of a declared mutation run (/test Step 5.5), a declared expected exit code of a check command (exit 2 of scripts/itd_stop_rule.py --check-binding), and a red signal keyed by a one-off command that a later green run of the same oracle script supersedes - while a real failing test, an unexpected exit code and a red run without a later green run of the same script still block the commit; the new oracle tests/verify_completion_false_red.py is RED on the pre-fix code and GREEN after, and tests/verify_completion_gate.py and tests/verify_completion_adversarial_corpus.py stay green.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_completion_false_red.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_completion_gate.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_completion_adversarial_corpus.py

units.criterion: ORACLE-LEGS-1: skills/_shared/itd_verification_loop.py machine, minting for the claim equal to the active follow-up unit, refuses before running any leg when a reviewEvidence.oracleIds entry of that unit's acceptance criteria is not among the --command leg ids, and the refusal names the criterion and the missing oracle; a :general-review claim and a complete leg set mint as before; the new oracle tests/verify_machine_oracle_legs.py is RED on the pre-fix code and GREEN after, and tests/verify_verification_loop.py and tests/verify_review_evidence.py stay green.

units.criterion: MEMORY-COLLISION-DENY-1: hooks/state-guard.sh denies a Write that would replace an existing session_*.md memory file younger than the collision window and names the next free suffix in its reason, while Edit, an append and a Write to a new file pass, within the existing per-session deny budget; the new oracle tests/verify_memory_collision_deny.py is RED on the pre-fix hook and GREEN after, and tests/verify_host_neutral_memory.py and tests/verify_all_hard_gate_host_parity.py stay green.
